questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the boundaries of the anterior triangle.
questions.modelAnswer:
Anteriorly: Anterior median line of neck
Posteriorly: Anterior border of sternomastoid
Superiorly: Inferior border of mandible and a line joining angle of mandible to mastoid process

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the boundaries of submental triangle.
questions.modelAnswer:
Base: Hyoid bone
Apex: Symphysis menti
On each side: Anterior belly of digastric
Floor: Two mylohyoid muscles

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the contents of submental triangle.
questions.modelAnswer: Submental lymph nodes, submental artery and vein, small veins that unite to form anterior jugular vein, mylohyoid nerve and vessels

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the boundaries of digastric triangle.
questions.modelAnswer:
Anteriorly: anterior belly of digastric
Posteriorly: posterior belly of digastric and stylohyoid
Superiorly: inferior border of mandible and a line drawn from angle of mandible to mastoid process
Roof: Skin, superficial fascia, deep fascia
Floor: Mylohyoid and hyoglossus

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention 5 contents of digastric triangle.
questions.modelAnswer:
Submandibular gland
Submandibular LN
Submandibular ganglion
Facial artery
Facial vein

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the boundaries of carotid triangle.
questions.modelAnswer:
Superiorly: Posterior belly of digastric
Anteriorly: Superior belly of omohyoid
Posteriorly: Anterior border of sternomastoid
Roof: skin, superficial fascia, investing layer of deep cervical fascia
Floor:Hyoglossus, thyrohyoid, middle and inferior constrictors of the pharynx

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention 3 contents of carotid triangle.
questions.modelAnswer: CCA, ICA, ECA

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the contents of the muscular triangle.
questions.modelAnswer: Infrahyoid muscles

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: What is the nerve supply of infrahyoid muscles?
questions.modelAnswer: All are supplied by ansa cervicalis except thyrohyoid which is supplied by C1 fibers that accompany hypoglossal nerve

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: What is the nerve supply of suprahyoid muscles?
questions.modelAnswer:
Ant belly of digastric and mylohyoid by nerve to mylohyoid
Post belly of digastric and stylohyoid by facial nerve
Geniohyoid by C1 via hypoglossal nerve

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: What is the structure of ansa cervicalis?
questions.modelAnswer:
It’s formed of 2 limbs:
Superior limb: fibers from C1 that join hypoglossal nerve then leave it and descend infront of carotid sheath
Inferior limb: fibers from C2 and C3

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Compare between the cervical sympathetic ganglion(site)
questions.modelAnswer:
Superior cervical ganglion: C2,3
Middle cervical ganglion: C6,7
Inferior cervical ganglion: C7

questions.subject: Anatomy
questions.text: Mention the branches of glossopharyngeal nerve.
questions.modelAnswer:
Tympanic branch
Carotid branch
Pharyngeal
Muscular
Tonsillar
